verdict.rationale: Jules is a cloud agent, but its documented REST API lets scripts and pipelines drive it without the web UI. You authenticate with API keys, create sessions, send messages and approve plans programmatically, and an optional automationMode controls PR creation. One community user corroborates the API by dispatching tasks to it from their own MCP server. Headless use from CI/shell is achievable through raw API calls, but nothing describes a direct CI/CD or shell integration. Missing for 10: an official CLI for shell-script use, documented CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions example), and independent reports of running Jules inside a pipeline.
